fields.title: Start Using
fields.description: When the player begins using the item. Use `always` to start as soon as the use action is triggered (default), or `on_attack` to start using only when an attack input is received while the item is selected.

generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.title: Item Use Modifiers
generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Modifies use behavior, including how long the item takes to use and the player's movement speed.

fields.title: Emit Vibrations
fields.description: Whether vibrations are emitted when the item starts or stops being used.

fields.title: Movement Modifier
fields.description: Multiplier applied to the player's movement speed while the item is in use.

fields.title: Start Sound
fields.description: Sound played when the item starts being used. Accepts the name of any sound event defined in `sound_definitions.json`, including the built-in vanilla sound events.

fields.title: Start Using
fields.description: Controls how using the item triggers start using behavior. "if_first" only starts if no other component has started using yet; "always" always restarts using. Defaults to "if_first".

fields.title: Use Duration
fields.description: Time, in seconds, that the item takes to use.

description: Determines how long an item takes to use in combination with components such as Shooter, Throwable, or Food.
